# Primitives

<div class="odv-pagehero"><div><p>The raw values of Content first. Primitives hold the values; semantic tokens give them a job (see <a href="../foundations/">Foundations</a>), and components read only the jobs. Spare values stay, so a brand or a changed answer can use them without adding a value.</p><div class="odv-stats"><span><b>115</b>Primitives</span><span><b>77</b>In use</span><span><b>38</b>Spare</span></div></div><span class="odv-robot odv-pagehero-robot"><img class="odv-robot-day" src="/robots/measure.webp" alt="" loading="lazy"/><img class="odv-robot-night" src="/robots/measure-dark.webp" alt="" loading="lazy"/></span></div>
